title: skmgr manifest
description: Declarative list of AI agent skills and rules for a project. Lives in skmgr.yml (or skmgr.yaml) at the project root.

name.description: Project identifier. Conventionally the repository name.

targets.description: Agents every skill is linked into, unless a skill overrides it.

skills.description: The skills and rules this project depends on.

agent.description: An agent skmgr knows how to install for.

name.description: Local alias and directory name. Optional: derived from `path`, or from the repository name, when omitted. Must be a single path component.

source.description: Where the skill comes from: a git URL, a local path, a file:// URL, or a local git clone prefixed with git:: to make refs apply.

path.description: Subdirectory within the source. Supports a trailing wildcard to install every match, each named after its own directory.

ref.description: Version to install: a tag, branch, commit SHA, or a semver range such as ^1.2.0, ~1.2, or latest. A range resolves to the newest matching tag. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

type.description: A skill is a capability the agent can invoke; a rule is guidance merged into the agent's instructions.

scope.description: project installs into .agents/ in this repository; global installs into ~/.agents/ for every project on this machine.

targets.description: Agents for this skill only, overriding the manifest-level targets.
